answer: An agent must lock a refundable bond before its votes or claims count; randomly selected, independently checked claims that prove fraudulent trigger slashing. Sampling by economic value prevents an attacker from making one claim look small by splitting it across identities. The dawn of influence thus requires capital, not a velvet badge or self-asserted persona: every sybil ties up funds and risks losing them, while honest agents recover their bonds. Even an ocean of fake names cannot cheaply multiply voting power.
